target_customer: Independent retailers in Asia buying wholesale inventory from brands
problem: Independent retailers in Asia struggle to source inventory from brands with fair terms. Peeba offered a marketplace with free returns and 60 day payment terms, selling on a consignment style model.
business_model: B2B wholesale marketplace with take rate and pay later or sell first pay later terms

founders.name: Jacky Lai
previous_startups: Ran two earlier companies including an e-commerce business grown to over 40M USD in annual sales (names not given)
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch says over a decade in tech and supply chain management.

founders.name: Kevin Cho
previous_startups: Medifly.ai (listed as CEO on YC page)
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder by TechCrunch and YC page.

exit.reason: Company website carries a farewell message saying Peeba has ceased operations; no reason given

competitors.name: GudangAda
competitors.what: Indonesian B2B marketplace for fast moving consumer goods serving small retailers
competitors.traction_then: About half a million SME users across about 500 cities at its peak per a later profile
competitors.funding_then: Raised more than 100M USD in a Series B in July 2021

competitors.name: Ula
competitors.what: Indonesian wholesale e-commerce marketplace with pay later terms for warungs
competitors.traction_then: Around 6,000 products and 70,000 warung clients at its 2021 raise
competitors.funding_then: Series B of 87M USD led by Prosus, Tencent and B Capital in October 2021

technical_complexity.rationale: Marketplace software with cross border logistics and ML product discovery; the hard parts were operations and credit terms rather than technology.

defensibility.rationale: Brand and retailer supply could create two sided effects, but better funded Indonesian rivals sold to the same retailers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals Ula and others also struggled, with Ula reportedly ceasing operations in 2025; no source shows an incumbent acquiring Peeba.

market_need_then: Independent retailers in Asia faced fragmented wholesale supply and many such marketplaces drew large 2021 funding, showing investor belief in demand. Peeba claimed 2,500 brands and 13 markets in its YC launch.

identity.voice_and_tone: Retailer friendly messaging about risk free wholesale, free returns and payment terms

branding.brand_signature: Sell first, pay later terms for small retailers
branding.community_and_virality: Covered by TechCrunch, PYMNTS, TechNode and Katadata around the 2022 raise and 2023 Indonesia launch; no merch or community found

brand_strength.rationale: Press covered funding and launch but no source shows a recognizable brand among retailers.

pivots.from: Hong Kong based wholesale marketplace serving retailers across Asia
pivots.to: Southeast Asia expansion with an Indonesia office and consignment style model
pivots.why: Described as the first step of its Southeast Asia expansion; not a full pivot

outcome_analysis: Peeba raised a 4.2M seed in April 2022 and expanded into Indonesia in 2023 with a sell first pay later model, reaching a team of about 30. Its website now says it ceased operations, with no reason or date. Failure factors are inferred from the working capital heavy model and the weak funding climate for Indonesian B2B marketplaces, where rival Ula also collapsed, but Peeba never stated a cause.
notes: Seed of 4.2M confirmed by TechCrunch, Retail in Asia and PYMNTS. Outlets differ on the lead (Headline Asia vs Headline Ventures). TechCrunch says total raised is 5.8M after the seed, implying roughly 1.6M earlier not found; CB Insights gives 4.7M total and Seedtable only the seed, so earlier funding is a recorded gap. YC page lists founded 2020 and Hong Kong HQ per press while directory location is Jakarta. Shutdown date unknown; the failure factors are inferences, not company statements.
